theme: Dark Cinematic Adventure (TV) + Tactile Field Notebook (Mobile)

headings.usage: Used for all main titles, TV dramatic reveals, and player names. Gives an ancient, adventurous, Indiana Jones-esque feel.

body.usage: Highly readable, modern, clean. Used for multiple choice questions, clues, and UI elements. Excellent legibility for all ages.

visual_enhancers.tv_surface: Crystal Glassmorphism over ancient backgrounds: `backdrop-blur-2xl bg-midnight/60 border border-bronze/20 shadow-2xl`. Never use raw transparency.
visual_enhancers.mobile_surface: Tactile Notebook: Solid `bg-dark_charcoal` or `bg-ivory_parchment` with sharp inner contrasts (`border-black/10`). Avoid excessive glassmorphism on the phone to maintain the 'field notebook' illusion.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle SVG noise or grain overlay to backgrounds to kill 'digital flatness' and simulate ancient parchment or stone.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders tinted with Bronze (`border-[#C89B3C]/30`) to frame cards and sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Warm, ambient shadows. Example: `shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(200,155,60,0.1)]` for gold highlights.

tv_host_screen.grid: Center-focused for narrative moments (Dice Roll, Winner Reveal) transitioning to Split-Screen (Question + Map/Travel Animation).
tv_host_screen.spacing: Extremely generous. `p-12` to `p-24`. Content must breathe and be visible from the couch.
tv_host_screen.background: Full viewport immersive images with a `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0B1320] via-[#0B1320]/80 to-transparent` overlay.

mobile_companion.grid: Mobile-first standard flow. Bottom Navigation for notebook tabs (Personajes, Lugares, Acontecimientos, Pistas).
mobile_companion.cards: Bento-style candidate grids. 2-column or 3-column. Use heavy dimming/grayscale for 'greyed-out' discarded clues.
mobile_companion.touch_targets: Minimum `h-14`, large padding `p-4` or `p-6` to ensure it works beautifully for adults and kids.

admin_panel.grid: Standard sidebar + main content area. High density grid (`gap-4`).
admin_panel.styling: Use standard Shadcn, but apply the `deep_midnight` and `ancient_bronze` subtly so it feels connected to the game.

motion.dice_roll: 3D Physics or High-fidelity Framer Motion sequence. The dice MUST feel weighty and ancient.
motion.reveals: Dramatic fade-in-up (`translate-y-8 opacity-0` to `translate-y-0 opacity-100`) with a stagger effect.
motion.feedback: Correct: Pulse subtle green, unlock sound. Incorrect: Shake (x-axis), subtle red flash.
motion.winner: Confetti (using `react-confetti`), golden light sweep across the screen, massive scale-in of the winner's name.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast by applying text shadows or dark/light scrims.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements on Mobile must have clear focus/active states (`active:scale-95`).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="roll-dice-btn"`, `data-testid="clue-card"`).

tv_background_night_ruins.description: Dark ancient desert ruins under night sky. Use for TV Host lobby and suspense backgrounds. Apply heavy dark overlay.

map_parchment.description: Old treasure map with compass on a wooden table. Use for the Mobile Map view or TV travel animation background.

stone_temple_warm.description: Sunlight streaming into an ancient stone temple corridor. Use for successful revelations or the Winner screen on TV.

investigation_notebook.description: Magnifying glass and vintage items lying on an old map. Perfect hero graphic for the TV lobby or mobile login screen.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use `framer-motion` for complex 2D animations (travel map, card reveals). For the 3D dice, you can use `framer-motion-3d` or `react-three-fiber` if you want a true 3D rolling physics object. If 3D is too complex for the timeframe, use a high-quality CSS 3D transform cube with rapid rotation.

component_instructions.buttons: Do NOT use generic Shadcn buttons for the game UI. Mobile game buttons should be chunky, tactile, with `border-b-4 border-bronze-dark` to feel pressable.
component_instructions.cards: For 'MI EXPEDIENTE', candidate cards must show visual state clearly: 'unknown' (normal), 'discarded' (grayscale, opacity-50, maybe an X overlay), 'recovered' (golden glow, checkmark).
component_instructions.inputs: Use Shadcn for the Admin Panel and Mobile Join Flow, but customize Mobile inputs to have larger text, larger padding, and a warm beige/dark charcoal theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a dual-interface game (TV screen + Mobile Phone). This requires careful responsive design and potentially separate route structures (e.g., /host vs /play).
DO NOT make the TV interface look like an admin dashboard. It is a cinematic experience. Use large, dramatic typography and full-bleed background images.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background in overlays or floating UI elements over images. ALWAYS use a backdrop-blur with a semi-opaque color (e.g., bg-black/60).
The Phone UI is a 'field notebook'. Keep it dark or warm ivory, focused on large grid cards and easy tapping.
Implement WebSockets effectively to push updates from the server to the TV and Mobile instantly.
Make sure the multiple-choice questions on the TV are massive—readable from across a living room.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
